newsitem.title: DENMARK: Carlsberg to build Egyptian brewery.
newsitem.headline: Carlsberg to build Egyptian brewery.

text.p: Danish brewer Carlsberg said on Tuesday that it had finalised a deal for its Danbrew unit to build a brewery in Egypt in co-operation with al-Ahram Beverages.

A Carlsberg spokesman declined to give financial details of the agreement or its likely effect on group earnings but the Luxor Group, al-Ahram's U.S.-based majority shareholder, said last month that the new building would cost $50 million.
Carlsberg said that the brewery, in the satellite city of Obour northeast of Cairo, would brew Carlsberg beer under license, among other products. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
